categories.main_business_segments: Cubic Sensor and Instrument Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of gas sensors and gas analysis instruments. Its primary business segments include HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning), industrial and safety, automotive electronics, medical health, smart metering, scientific instruments, and low-carbon thermal engineering. The company offers a wide range of products such as dust sensors, CO2 sensors, integrated air quality sensor modules, VOC sensors, oxygen sensors, and high-end gas analysis instruments used in environmental monitoring, industrial process control, and smart metering.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages multiple core gas sensing technologies including non-dispersive infrared (NDIR), light scattering detection (LSD), ultrasonic, ultraviolet differential absorption spectroscopy (UV-DOAS), thermal conductivity detection (TCD), laser Raman spectroscopy, metal oxide semiconductor (MOX) MEMS, electrochemical, and high-temperature solid electrolyte principles. It has developed proprietary MEMS chips, infrared detectors, laser sources, and other key components, supported by 12 specialized laboratories and advanced manufacturing capabilities covering injection molding, SMT, sensor assembly, and integrated device production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cubic serves a diverse customer base across HVAC, industrial safety, automotive, medical devices, smart metering, scientific research, and low-carbon heating sectors. Its products are widely used by leading domestic and international enterprises, including world top 500 companies, in applications such as air quality monitoring, refrigerant leak detection, automotive emission control, medical respiratory equipment, and environmental monitoring. The company also targets emerging markets like new energy vehicles, semiconductor manufacturing, and energy storage safety.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Wuhan and subsidiaries in Jiaxing, Guangdong, Chongqing, Hong Kong, and Hungary. It has established an overseas production base in Hungary to enhance responsiveness to European customers and expand international market share. Its products are exported to over 80 countries and regions globally, with growing presence in Europe, Asia, the Americas, and Belt and Road countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cubic operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the gas sensing and analysis supply chain. It develops and manufactures core sensing components and complete sensor modules, as well as integrated gas analysis instruments and systems. The company has vertically integrated capabilities including in-house production of key components like MEMS chips, infrared sources, and ceramic parts, and provides one-stop supply chain solutions encompassing sensors, actuators, and controllers for applications such as gas boilers and HVAC systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening its core gas sensing technology platforms and expanding applications in HVAC, industrial safety, automotive electronics, medical health, smart metering, scientific instruments, and low-carbon thermal engineering. It emphasizes innovation in microfluidic infrared sensing, laser Raman spectroscopy, and integrated multi-sensor arrays. R&D efforts focus on product miniaturization, integration, intelligence, and low power consumption, alongside expanding patent portfolios and strengthening collaborations with top universities and research institutes. The company also invests in digital transformation and ESG initiatives to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Cubic generates revenue primarily through product sales of gas sensors, gas analysis instruments, and integrated systems. It operates under a self-owned brand model with direct sales to end customers and supplemented by distributor channels. The company also provides ODM solutions and technical services including pre-sales support, project management, and after-sales service. Revenue is recognized mainly at the point of product delivery or upon customer acceptance for system products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cubic is recognized as a leading domestic and international player in the gas sensor and scientific instrument industry. It holds the global number one market share in PM sensors according to Yole Intelligence. The company competes with global comprehensive sensor manufacturers like Amphenol, Bosch, and Sensirion, as well as specialized firms in gas analysis instruments such as Siemens, ABB, and Thermo Fisher. Cubic is positioned as a high-tech innovator with strong R&D capabilities and a growing international footprint, actively pursuing domestic substitution and global expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Cubic achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 873 million, a 26.23% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in automotive electronics, scientific instruments, smart metering, and industrial safety segments. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 112.75 million, down 15.03% due to increased R&D, sales, and management expenses for sustainable development. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.55 billion, up 25.01%, with net assets of RMB 1.03 billion, up 6.91%. R&D investment accounted for 12.96% of revenue, reflecting a strong innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cubic emphasizes its comprehensive multi-technology gas sensing platforms, enabling high precision, long life, low power consumption, and integrated multi-gas detection capabilities. Its products offer superior stability, sensitivity, and anti-interference performance, supported by proprietary MEMS and laser technologies. The company provides end-to-end solutions from sensors to integrated systems, backed by strong R&D, quality control, and global certifications. Its commitment to innovation, domestic substitution, and internationalization differentiates it as a trusted partner for high-value customers in diverse industries.
